description.value: Booster Juice is a Canadian juice-bar chain offering freshly blended smoothies, cold-pressed juices, açai bowls, and light food items with a focus on health and active lifestyles. This location sits in a retail unit at 4949 Canoe Pass Way in Tsawwassen, near the BC Ferries terminal area. The menu is entirely vegetarian and vegan-friendly, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists seeking a lighter, nutrient-dense option.
